name: Soul Link
source:
Fall, 2045C.E. Aizawa Shuuhei, a second-year cadet enrolled in Central Military Academy's primary division, is dispatched to Aries's orbital space station on a training mission. He reunites with his younger brother, Ryouta, and his childhood friend, Nao, both of whom reside there as cadets enrolled in the preparatory division.

Then an unidentified spaceship under the control of Jararacas, a radical terrorist organization, suddenly attacks the Aries and seizes control of the main control room. With all communication lines cut off, Shuuhei and the others have no way to escape. Trapped in space, 250 miles above the Earth, they have nowhere to run. Amid this desperate situation, the cadets must gather their courage and rise to take back the Aries. As they do, they draw ever closer to the horrifying truth lurking behind this incident...

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/884B45F6-D0F3-4CBA-A6F8-C13EA54E3B87/soul-link]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
2045年秋。相泽修平是中央军事学院初级部的二年级学员，被派往白羊座号轨道空间站执行训练任务。他与弟弟凉太以及青梅竹马奈绪重逢，两人都是预科部的学员，驻扎在那里。

随后，一艘由激进恐怖组织贾拉拉卡斯操控的不明飞船突然袭击了白羊座号，并夺取了主控制室的控制权。所有通讯线路被切断，修平等人无处可逃。被困在距地球250英里的太空中，他们无路可退。在这绝望的处境下，学员们必须鼓起勇气，奋起夺回白羊座号。而在这一过程中，他们越来越接近潜伏在这起事件背后的恐怖真相……
